exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to give, to proffer, to pass
to sound, to ring out (usually unexpectedly), to go off (e.g. telephone, gunshot)
to turn out well, to be a success
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: подава́ть — to give, to proffer, to pass; разда́ться — to sound, to ring out (usually unexpectedly), to go off (e.g. telephone, gunshot); уда́ться — to turn out well, to be a success; прода́ть — to sell.
**Подающим** — подава́ть (imperfective): to give, to proffer, to pass; to serve; (sports) to pitch, to serve, to pass; to give alms. Wiktionary: по- + дава́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **Раздался** — разда́ться (perfective): to sound, to ring out (usually unexpectedly), to go off (e.g. telephone, gunshot); (dated) to give way, to make way; to move aside; to expand, to become wide; to gain weight. Wiktionary: раз- + дать + -ся.
